notes.title: Actual Final Achievement Fix
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! ^-^ 

Thank you again for waiting so long. This game only has one developer, so progress can get bogged down by other things I need to take care of first. So, since I had sat down with some time to spend on the game, I sorted out the final bugs with the steam achievements! >w>;;; 

Any issues people may have will be kept note of and fixed asap! Thanks again to everyone who has played the game so far <3 

- Cavitees

notes.title: Acheievements Fixed!
notes.content:
Okay hey wow! The Steam Achievements are fixed!! Finally!! (So so sorry to everyone for keeping you waiting so long. I'm sure some issues are going to pop up, but do know that I'll be on it ASAP when they do. 

- Cavi
